title: Smooth algebras over normal domains admit Noetherian normal base models in a filtered colimit
statement: Let $R$ be an integrally closed integral domain [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring], let $S$ be a commutative ring, and let $f:R\to S$ be smooth [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map]. There exist a small filtered category $I$, a diagram $F:I\to\mathrm{CommRing}$ with a colimit [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], and a ring isomorphism $\operatorname{colim} F\cong S$, such that for every $i\in I$ there is a Noetherian commutative ring $A_i$ [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] which is normal [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring], together with a smooth ring map $g_i:A_i\to F(i)$. Here normal means every prime localization is an integrally closed domain; no normality of $F(i)$ or $S$ is part of the conclusion. When $R$ and $S$ have universes $u,v$, the index and all the models can be chosen in universe $\max(u,v)$.

source.place: Tag 033C (lemma-normal-goes-up), third paragraph; checked at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/033C

proof.text: Lift R to ULift R in universe max(u,v), transporting its domain and integral-closure properties along the ring equivalence. Compose the given smooth map with this equivalence. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-smooth-algebra-finite-type-model], implemented by Mathlib Algebra.Smooth.exists_subalgebra_fg over Z, to obtain A0, B, smoothness of B over A0, finite generation of A0, and S isomorphic to the lifted R tensor over A0 B.

Let P consist of the finitely generated, integrally closed integer subalgebras A of lifted R which contain A0. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-normal-finite-type-subalgebra-extension] to A0 for nonemptiness, to the supremum of any two members for directedness, and to A0 joined with the subalgebra generated by x for a member containing each x.

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-directed-subalgebra-tensor-colimit] to the directed covering family P and B. Compose its colimit ring equivalence with the smooth-descent ring equivalence to identify the colimit with S.

For each tensor stage, use its supplied base subalgebra A. Finite generation over Z gives Noetherianity by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra-noetherian]. Base-change smoothness [lem-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map-base-change-composition] gives smoothness of A to A tensor B; compose with the stage ring equivalence. As a subalgebra of a domain, A is a domain, and by its membership in P it is integrally closed. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-localization-normal-domain] to every prime localization. This supplies exactly the bases and smooth maps in the original conclusion, in universe max(u,v).

proof_origin.place: Tag 033C, third paragraph; the normalization and directed-union route is retained, with a direct tensor universal-property proof instead of the elementwise module-colimit route

lean.statement: theorem exists_noetherian_normal_model_colimit {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [IsDomain R] [IsIntegrallyClosed R] {f : R →+* S} (hf : f.Smooth) : ∃ (I : Type (max u v)) (_ : SmallCategory I) (_ : IsFiltered I) (F : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{max u v}) (_ : HasColimit F), Nonempty ((colimit F : CommRingCat.{max u v}) ≃+* S) ∧ ∀ i : I, ∃ (A : Type (max u v)) (_ : CommRing A) (_ : IsNoetherianRing A) (g : A →+* F.obj i), g.Smooth ∧ ∀ (p : Ideal A) [p.IsPrime], IsDomain (Localization.AtPrime p) ∧ IsIntegrallyClosed (Localization.AtPrime p)
